Pluto TV is offering thousands of free movies.
All the mentioned movies on Pluto TV are accessible at no cost.
Blockbuster films such as Gladiator, Mission Impossible, Beverly Hills Cop, and Good Burger are available on Pluto TV.
The current promotion is ongoing now ('Extreme now').
There will be no future payment required to access these movies ('pay never').

assumptions.text: Viewers value free access to popular blockbuster films.
Audiences trust that 'free' means truly without cost and without hidden fees.
People perceive Pluto TV as a credible and reliable platform for movie streaming.
The speaker’s claim of ‘extreme’ availability implies high volume and urgency, which motivates action.
Consumers prioritize convenience and immediate access over subscription models during promotional events.
The inclusion of nostalgic titles like Good Burger appeals to emotional attachment and shared cultural memory.
